zh.askTitle: 换成你们家的车型报价、里程和充电条件，五年总花费就按你们的情况重算
zh.runTitle: 曼谷四口之家 2027 年初买车：预算 100–130 万泰铢，纯电、混动、燃油三选一

fields.label: 具体配置和落地报价
fields.placeholder: 例如：比亚迪 ATTO 3 Extended 落地价 85 万泰铢

fields.label: 年里程和出行
fields.value: 每年约 18,000 公里，主要是市区，每月去一趟华欣

fields.label: 公寓许可、电表费率和全包安装报价
fields.value: 住在曼谷 Bang Na 的公寓，有一个固定车位，还没有私人充电桩

fields.label: 保险保养轮胎报价
fields.placeholder: 例如：保险年费 2.5 万泰铢

fields.label: 可接受的公共充电时间
fields.placeholder: 例如：路上充电最多等 40 分钟

zh.template: 请根据{grades}、{mileage}、{finance}、{charging}、{insurance}和{chargetime}，比较我们家的曼谷买车方案。分开现金流和持有成本，测试充电比例和转售价，并标出政策或规格待核事项。联系别人或分享文件前先问我。

phases.title: 查泰国官方车价、持有成本、补贴政策和公寓充电可行性
phases.note: 车厂官网价格、电费与油价、公共充电费率、电动车补贴和年税规定
phases.judgment: 几条网上流传的说法，它都对到官方文本去核实：电动车补贴（2.5 万 / 5 万泰铢）只适用于本地生产车型，不是所有电动车都有；年税减免 80% 只给 2025 年 11 月 10 日前的登记、只有一年，不是五年；2027 年进口电动车消费税 35% 只在一篇新闻里看到，找不到泰国的正式文件，就明确标成“未确认”。

phases.title: 搭五年总花费模型，写完整的英文网页指南
phases.note: 六款车型的贷款、电费油费、保险保养和转售估算

phases.title: 独立重算、测电脑和手机版式，交付三份文件
phases.judgment: 独立复核的同事不用主流程的生成脚本，自己把每个金额重算一遍：373 项核对，零差异。它还确认座位数的说明已经改掉了先前说过头的写法，并指出一处来源措辞不准：AXA 页面写的是“起价 645.21 泰铢”，不是文中的精确分类。

workers: 查泰国官网上四款车型的标价和规格：两款纯电、两款混动
查补贴、消费税、年税、强制险的官方规定，以及公寓装充电桩的许可要求
查曼谷的电费、公共充电费率和油价，并标明生效日期
独立复核：重算每个金额，核对结论与来源清单是否一致

en.runTitle: A Bangkok family of four buying in early 2027: THB 1.0–1.3 million, choosing between electric, hybrid and petrol

fields.label: exact grades and delivered quotes
fields.placeholder: e.g. BYD ATTO 3 Extended, THB 850,000 delivered

fields.label: annual mileage and trips
fields.value: About 18,000 km a year, mostly city traffic plus monthly trips to Hua Hin

fields.label: cash or full finance terms
fields.value: Financing at a typical Thai rate

fields.label: condo permission, meter/tariff and all-in installation quote
fields.value: Condo in Bang Na with one assigned parking bay, no private charger yet

fields.label: public-charging time we accept
fields.placeholder: e.g. up to 40 minutes at a public charger

en.template: Compare our Bangkok family-car choices using {grades}, {mileage}, {finance}, {charging}, {insurance} and {chargetime}. Separate cash flow from ownership cost, test charging share and resale, and flag unresolved policy or specification checks. Ask before contacting anyone or sharing our documents.

phases.title: Check Thai official car prices, running costs, incentives and condo charging feasibility
phases.note: Maker price pages, electricity and fuel prices, public charging tariffs, EV subsidy and annual tax rules
phases.judgment: It checked several widely repeated claims against the official text: the EV subsidy (THB 25,000 / 50,000) covers domestically produced cars, not every EV; the 80% annual-tax cut applies only to registrations up to 10 Nov 2025 and for one year, not five; and the 35% imported-EV excise rate for 2027 appeared only in a news article with no Thai official document found, so it is marked unconfirmed.

phases.title: Build the five-year cost model and a complete English guide
phases.note: Loan, electricity and fuel, insurance, servicing and resale estimates for six models

phases.title: Independent recalculation, desktop and phone layout tests, then deliver three files
phases.judgment: The independent colleague recomputed every money figure without using the guide’s own generator: 373 checks, zero mismatches. It also confirmed the seating-capacity wording now replaces an earlier overclaim, and flagged one source wording that was off: the AXA page says “starts at THB 645.21”, not the precise classification the guide stated.

workers: Found the listed prices and specifications of four models on Thai manufacturer sites: two electric, two hybrid
Checked the official rules on subsidy, excise, annual tax and compulsory insurance, and what a condo needs to approve a charger
Collected Bangkok electricity, public charging and fuel prices, each with its effective date
Independent check: recomputed every money figure and matched the conclusions to the source list
